admin.title: IPv6 observation
admin.subtitle: Where observed IPv6 addresses come from and which prefixes are watched
admin.sourcesHelp: Addresses come from the neighbor table of each node and, with the DHCPv6 module, from the Kea DHCPv6 leases.
admin.settingsHelp: Thresholds and the neighbor tables are settings of the ipv6 domain.

prefixes.title: Watched prefixes
prefixes.help: Only addresses in a watched prefix are kept. By default: the IPv6 reverse zones served, the DHCPv6 subnets and the prefixes of the nodes' own addresses. ULA prefixes are watched only when listed.
prefixes.listedHelp: One prefix per line, added to the defaults
